evidence.observation: Reported reboiler temperature is 356.129 °C versus 92.718 °C at T702, an unusually large temperature discontinuity requiring validation.

The discontinuity persists: T701 is 358.177 °C, T702 is 94.561 °C, and the upper-column readings are 71.188 and 70.824 °C; these readings do not establish whether the reboiler is genuinely hot or its measurement is faulty.
System pressure is 698.215 mbar and differential pressures are 0.816 and 1.920 mbar, close to initial values; no corresponding pressure excursion identifies a leak or blockage.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration and tag/unit verification, and protocol temperature limits are needed to distinguish actual overheating from a measurement fault. No composition measurement or target composition has been supplied.
